text:
zoe_sales: Heads-up - Meridian Finance POC blocked. Dedicated pool in eu-west1-b won't provision (AZ affinity required). Also hit external IP quota. Need SE + infra swarm.
liam_se: Can you paste the exact errors?
zoe_sales: Screenshot showed: ```Provision failed: NoAvailableGPUs: requested 4xH100 in eu-west1-b, available 0. az_affinity=required.``` And: ```Static IP allocation failed: QUOTA_EXCEEDED for project meridian-prod.```
ana_cs: Procurement needs a quick compare: 10-day on-demand burst vs 12-month reserved commit. Security also asked if we support CMEK and exporting audit logs to their Splunk. Quick yes/no will unblock.
liam_se: Ballpark: 12mo commit ~30% cheaper than on-demand. 10-day 4xH100 burst = rough estimate 0. Placeholder until infra confirms.
sam_infra: Two distinct issues: hardware availability in eu-west1-b and STATIC_ADDRESSES quota. I'll try a smaller allocation (1xH100) and a private-only endpoint to avoid the IP quota. If AZ affinity is strict we must open a provider capacity ticket.
liam_se: Customer insists on AZ affinity for PCI reasons so fallback is not allowed without written approval. If 1x also fails, escalate to provider.
zoe_sales: Please try 1xH100 private-only so they can run internal tests.
sam_infra: Running: ```rdwctl provision --dedicated --region eu-west1 --zone eu-west1-b --gpus 1 --type h100 --affinity required --no-external-ip``` -> infra-bot: [provision] req=md-8901, status=allocated, endpoint=10.5.33.12
zoe_sales: Nice, they can run internal smoke tests. They still need external IPs for e2e. Open quota ticket and capacity ticket.
sam_infra: Opened tickets: [support] GC-9901 capacity request (eu-west1-b), [quota] Q-4478 STATIC_ADDRESSES +30. Typical ETA: capacity 6-48h, IP quota <2h.
ana_cs: Security answer: "Yes - Dedicated supports customer-managed keys (CMEK) and audit logs can be exported to Splunk or cloud logging. Contact security@redwood.com for SOC2 artifacts."
liam_se: Pricing interim: 1xH100 test inexpensive for short smoke; 4xH100 10-day burst estimate will be 0 (placeholder). I'll post final table after provider confirms capacity.
sam_infra: Quota Q-4478 approved, new STATIC_ADDRESSES=45. Allocating external IP now: ```rdwctl attach-external --endpoint 10.5.33.12``` -> infra-bot: [ip-assign] ip=35.198.60.21 assigned
zoe_sales: Customer can run e2e now. They asked for final numbers for procurement tomorrow. Liam please post concrete numbers when ready.
liam_se: Will do. Tag me on provider ticket updates.
zoe_sales: Thanks all, will update Meridian procurement. :thumbsup:
